answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The plume is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ridge. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the sable is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
